title: Relay friction: Codex brief sets GOCACHE under .scratch; no ui role in relay-run; spec names data source

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S83 relay (run-20261023-120600-fe40): the Codex sandbox cannot write ~/Library/Caches/go-build, so the first implementer round stopped at 'operation not permitted'; the brief should set GOCACHE under .scratch. The first brief made Codex ask an owner question about 'matrix rows' instead of reading design.md:152, so a spec should name its data source. relay-run has no ui role, so the UI pass was recorded as reviewer. slicer start and done worked in the Codex sandbox with no .git denial. Candidates for slicer or the agents repo; check ownership before filing there.

S40 relay: with GOCACHE=.scratch/gocache set in the brief, Codex ran go commands in the sandbox with no denials, and resuming with 'codex exec resume --last' with stdin from a file avoided the stall. The Codex sandbox prints a harmless 'Unable to open session log file ... starship' on each shell call. A prompt test that only checks text is present does not check where it sits.
